audition.definitionKo: 가수, 탤런트, 배우 등의 연예인을 뽑기 위한 실기 시험.
audition.englishDescription: A performance test for selecting entertainers, especially singers and actors.

aurora.definitionKo: 태양으로부터 날아온 전기를 띤 입자가 공기와 반응하여 대기 중에서 빛을 내는 현상.
aurora.englishDescription: A phenomenon of light display which is caused as charged particles from the sun collide with the atmosphere.

category.englishDescription: The class or scope of things which have common traits.

despite.englishExpression: even so; despite; in spite of
despite.englishDescription: Being in fact as such, but regardless of that.

dissimulate.definitionKo: 자기가 하고도 하지 않은 척하거나 알면서도 모르는 척하다.
dissimulate.englishExpression: feign innocence; dissimulate; remove a tag that identifies the owner of a hawk
dissimulate.englishDescription: To pretend not to have done something or pretend to be ignorant of something that one actually knows about.

dissimulate.definitionKo: 자기가 하고도 하지 않은 척하거나 알면서도 모르는 척하다.
dissimulate.englishExpression: feign innocence; dissimulate; remove a tag that identifies the owner of a hawk
dissimulate.englishDescription: To pretend not to have done something or pretend to be ignorant of something that one actually knows about.

incentive.definitionKo: 의욕을 높이기 위하여 제공하는 각종 혜택.
incentive.englishDescription: A variety of benefits given to enhance someone's motivation to work.

initial.definitionKo: 이름, 고유 명사 등의 단어나 문장의 첫 번째 글자를 알파벳 대문자로 나타낸 것.
initial.englishDescription: The first letter of a word like a name, proper noun, etc., written in the capitalized alphabet.

staff.definitionKo: 연기자를 제외하고 연극, 영화, 방송의 제작에 참여하는 모든 사람.
staff.englishDescription: Anyone who participates in the production of a play, film, or broadcast, excluding actors.

taboo.definitionKo: 어떤 집단이나 사회에서 금지하는 말이나 행동.
taboo.englishDescription: A word or an act that is forbidden within a certain group or society.
